//: Glass pixels of window tiles, for the window light. Bit order: row by row, top left first, most significant bit first (numpy.packbits). 'sheer' (optional) marks a sheer curtain, which lets part of the light through; a pixel that is glass is never sheer. 'sheerColour' is the curtain's own colour, three bytes (red, green, blue) per pixel in the same order, zero off the curtain, so the light through it can take its colour. 'art' lists the fingerprints of the art the glass was found on; a tile whose live art matches none of them is not given glass. A tile whose sheet name is shared by different pictures lists them under 'variants', each with its own glass and art. A tile or variant with no glass bits is a window checked and found to have none. 'curtainMods' lists the mods (Nexus ids, or 'vanilla') with a sheer curtain on some window. Written by tools/labelops/windowglass.py.
